scripts.check: npm run check:rust && npm run check:web && npm run check:python
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/desktop run tsc && npm --prefix apps/desktop run lint && npm --prefix apps/desktop test
scripts.check:python: python -m ruff check packages/ingestion .agent/skills && python -m ruff format --check packages/ingestion .agent/skills && python -m mypy --config-file packages/ingestion/pyproject.toml packages/ingestion/ingest && python -m pytest packages/ingestion/tests -q
